findings.title: The headline figures show no trend inside the month

location.description: The four headline figures at the top of the page: Beds sold, Room revenue, Beds filled and Average stay.

findings.viewer_experience: The viewer sees one number and a words-only comparison with October, so cannot tell whether the month climbed steadily, spiked or fell away at the end.

current.value: Each headline figure has a single number and one line of grey text comparing it with October, with no sign of how it moved during the month.

findings.target: Each headline figure shows how it moved during the month, beside the number.
findings.fix_direction: Let each figure carry a sense of its movement over the month, close to the number.
findings.source: Tufte, Beautiful Evidence, on showing change over time beside a number

closed_when.check: Look at the four headline figures and check that each shows how it moved during the month, not only its total.
